description:
Source: a retrospective over 25 agent sessions (2026-10-18 to 2026-11-11), followed by an adversarial re-check of each claim against origin/develop 4835f5a537.

Problem. The tracked mirrors (.claude/skills/todo/references/batch.md 'Member closeout', .claude/skills/shared-review-protocol/SKILL.md) say batch members run a local review. docs/agent/batch-feature-delivery.md and `make batch-member-check` say they do not; the leader reviews at landing. PR #4053 fixed the mirrors by bumping the catalog pin; PR #4061 reverted it because trunk.yml run 42528704141 failed in 'medium-test (shard 1)' on the merge commit 1bf490a1b3. The policy did not change.

Owner decision 2026-11-11: members do not review; find why trunk failed and re-land the pin with that fixed.

Change. Diagnose the trunk failure. skill-sync.conf has four pin groups. Bump two of them: the `benchbox` group (9d13c588, which carries release.md and compliance.md) and the group that holds todo and shared-review-protocol (cc8adf58). Leave shared-agent-execution (89da990e) and skill-sync (another source) alone. Bump them to the catalog revision recorded by skill-catalog-release-freeze-and-tpc-specs-20261111 (which also carries the member-review wording), regenerate mirrors with `make skill-sync` in the worktree, and update _project/analysis/batch-rollout-evidence.json in the same PR, as earlier pin bumps did (#3921, #3933, #4013): the test compares every tracked todo mirror file with the hashes recorded there, which is what #4053 missed.

Non-goals. No hand edits to any mirror. No change to batch tooling or to docs/agent/batch-feature-delivery.md.

Guardrails: work in a linked worktree (make worktree-create, then make agent-write-preflight); never edit the primary clone, and pass absolute worktree paths to every file tool; stage paths explicitly, never git add -A; no explanatory comments or docstrings (make comment-policy-check); heavy work only via make heavy-run, never forcing admission or skipping the test lock; never bypass a required check, ruleset, hold label or review gate, and never post a stand-in; change only the files this item names, and report anything else as noticed-but-not-touched; re-read every cited file on current origin/develop before editing, because the line numbers here are hints from 2026-11-11 (origin/develop 4835f5a537); close at a merged PR (make pr-open, make pr-arm), and finish this item only after the merge is observed.
